comments.body:
Thanks for the careful write-up and the tests. The bug you found in `SSETranslator` is real, but it turns out that class was never wired in: no file in the repo imports `src/proxy/sse-translator.ts`, in any commit of its history. The proxy pipes the gateway's stream through as-is and reads usage from its `message_delta` events itself, so the double `message_delta` could not reach a client.

Rather than fix code that never runs, we removed the file in 1c108dd, so I'm closing this PR.

One note in case you take on similar work: keeping the `message_delta` sent at `finish_reason` would also have dropped the trailing usage chunk that OpenAI-style streams send after it. Emitting the stop reason once, at `[DONE]`, keeps both the stop reason and the final usage.
